spans.text: Ensure generated media depicts subjects with dignity, agency, and authentic contextual realism
spans.note: The prompt is fundamentally oriented toward preventing representational harm. It explicitly mandates dignity, prevents stereotypical depictions, and includes safeguards against cultural misrepresentation. The community validation metric ensures that depicted communities would recognize assets as authentic and dignified.

spans.text: Never treat identity as a mere descriptor input. Identity is a domain requiring technical expertise to represent accurately.
spans.note: This is the core strength of the prompt. It is explicitly and thoroughly designed to combat stereotypes, ensure authentic cultural representation, prevent tokenism, and promote intersectional diversity across age, disability, socioeconomic status, and culture. It provides concrete technical mechanisms to achieve these goals.
